statement: You are given an unsorted integer array nums.
A consecutive sequence is a set of values x, x + 1, x + 2, … that all occur in nums. They can be anywhere in the array, in any order. Repeated values count once.
Return the length of the longest consecutive sequence, in O(n) time.

examples.explanation: 1, 2, 3 and 4 all occur, giving a sequence of length 4. 100 and 200 have no neighbours.
Every value from 1 to 9 occurs, so the whole array forms one sequence of length 9.
